findings.net: In Japan the holder of Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ is more likely than not to prevail against a VENQORI class 9 right reaching consumer measuring or monitoring apparatus, and unlikely to reach the downloadable app itself.
findings.legal_position: The Japan Patent Office's own record reads this mark as BENKURI where VENQORI reads BENKORI — one medial vowel apart in the script Japanese examination compares, and seven Latin characters sharing VEN- and -RI, before a buyer whose whole distinguishing signal is the typed name on a phone screen. The registered goods are consumer electronics — rechargeable batteries, cameras, earphones, plugs, chargers and non-medical monitoring apparatus (among broad goods) — carried on the Japanese examination group for measuring or testing instruments, so the right meets a class 9 specification that reaches a consumer water probe or strip reader and stops short of the downloadable app.
findings.practical_position: The proprietor is a Chinese company registered under an umbrella-trade name and holding this one Japanese right, with no other filing in the searched material. Its use of the name in Japan is unresolved rather than absent: a Venkuri-branded USB microphone and speakerphone was listed on Amazon Japan with customer reviews in 2021, and the listing identifies no company, so the registration cannot be treated as plainly vulnerable for non-use.

findings.net: Align Networks' pending enqor applications are more likely than not to fail as an objection to VENQORI in Korea, though they cover the same downloadable app software (among broad goods).
findings.legal_position: enqor and VENQORI share the rare -NQOR- spine but part as wholes: the Korean readings 엔코르 and 벤코리 differ at the opening syllable, which KIPO weighs heavily, and VENQORI carries a third syllable enqor does not. Against that, the class 9 specification covers downloadable computer software and smartphone application software and the class 42 specification covers app development, software-as-a-service and application-service provision (among broad goods) — the company's own goods and services, in the company's own territory, filed five months before this search.
findings.practical_position: The three applications are pending rather than registered and were filed as word-and-design, so a figurative element may carry part of the distinctiveness and the word-only conflict is correspondingly narrower. What they threaten is a citation in examination and an opposition in classes 9, 41 and 42, neither of which depends on this applicant reaching the Korean storefronts first. The applicant in this matter is unnamed, and Align Networks is a Seoul software company filing in the same three classes on the same timeline, so the applicant's legal name and corporate group must be confirmed before these applications are treated as a third party's.

findings.net: NXP's QORIQ registrations cover microprocessors and integrated circuits and do not reach the company's water-quality app or its training services in Japan or Korea.
findings.legal_position: The registered goods are microprocessors, customised and multi-core processors, semiconductors and integrated circuits; nothing in the specification reaches downloadable software, consumer measuring apparatus or online training. As wholes the marks also read apart — QORI sits in the tail of VENQORI and is bracketed by Q at both ends of QORIQ, and QORI carries a meaning of its own.
findings.practical_position: NXP is a large US proprietor holding this right in class 9 in both instructed territories, so it is a name the company will meet on the register rather than in its own market. Nothing about how the company would file, price or launch turns on it.

distinctiveness.read: A strong name to own. VENQORI is a coined word with no meaning in English, Japanese or Korean, and the register turned up no crowd around it, so the whole word carries the rights rather than any part of it.
distinctiveness.spectrum: Coined and fanciful in classes 9, 41 and 42 — no descriptive, laudatory, geographic or deceptive flag.

per_market.note: In katakana the name reads BENKORI, and that is where its distance from the live Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ registration is measured: one medial vowel.

Korean corporate names of the shape 'X + 코리아' are common enough that an ear may take 벤코리 as 'Ben-Korea' rather than as one coined word, which trims the inherent-distinctiveness argument in Korea specifically.

mark_assessment.connotation: The reading to know about is QORI — Quechua for gold — which the meaning sweep tied to scholarly material on gold mining and water contamination in the Andes: a positioning question for a water-quality brand rather than a registrability one. Across the English, Japanese and Korean forms searched, nothing else adverse came back.

third_party_rights.read: Two live rights reach the name in the instructed territories, and only one of them is registered. Neither covers the name itself.
third_party_rights.basis: The Japanese class 9 registration and the three pending Korean applications; no identical mark anywhere in the searched material.

objection_likelihood.read: An objection from either owner is possible rather than expected, and the likelier form is a citation in prosecution than a claim in the market.
objection_likelihood.basis: Findings 1 and 2 — one dormant-profile proprietor with unresolved use, one new filer whose applications have not published.

registrability.read: The name is registrable in both territories on its own merits, with two known citation obstacles to work through.

obstacles.note: Japan — the Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ registration sits in the examination group for measuring or testing instruments, which is where an apparatus-bearing class 9 specification would be examined.
Korea — the pending enqor application covers downloadable and smartphone application software.

Korea — the pending enqor application covers the training class as filed.

registrability.basis: The coined-word distinctiveness read plus the two live citation candidates in findings 1 and 2.

client_enforceability.read: A coined word with no crowd behind it is enforceable across its whole length, not merely against copies of one element.
client_enforceability.basis: The exact-name searches returned nothing live in either register, and the element has no common component to dilute it.
